name: Pain
source:
In a rural town a young boy stares at the night sky. Black shadow approaches him and takes the shape of a succubus woman. Succubus searches for a fresh soul, and boy does not value his life at this point anymore, so they make a deal. From this day environment around the boy changes little by little with every day...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/03/vn-of-month-december-2001-izumo.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
乡下小镇里，一名少年仰望着夜空。黑影向他靠近，化为魅魔女子的形态。魅魔正在寻找新鲜灵魂，而少年此时已经毫不珍惜自己的生命，于是双方达成交易。从这一天起，少年身边的环境开始日复一日地悄然改变……

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/03/vn-of-month-december-2001-izumo.html]vndbreview[/url]]
